name: locality
description: Drive a LAN-hosted llama.cpp LLM from VS Code with hard network isolation, workspace-scoped tools, and an approval-gated terminal.

commands.title: Please stage changes before generating a commit message.
Please stage changes before generating a commit message.

locality.endpoint.description: URL of the llama.cpp server. Use localhost or a private IP literal such as http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 or http://192.168.1.50:8080/v1; DNS hostnames are refused.

locality.model.description: Model id sent to llama.cpp. The Settings view populates this from the server's /v1/models endpoint.

enumDescriptions: Trust only structured tool calls returned by the server.
Prefer structured calls, recover leaked Gemma 4 syntax, and fall back to the Gemma legacy adapter when native tools are rejected.
Prefer structured calls, recover leaked Qwen 3 syntax, and fall back to the Qwen legacy adapter when native tools are rejected.
Prefer structured calls and recover leaked Muse Glimmer ATEM syntax. Muse requires native server tool support.
Prefer structured calls, recover leaked GPT-OSS Harmony syntax, and fall back to the Harmony legacy adapter when native tools are rejected.
locality.toolCallingMode.description: Tool-call transport and compatibility profile. Native server only requires a tool-aware server template; family profiles add narrowly scoped recovery and, where reliable, a legacy fallback.

locality.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for chat requests. Lower is more deterministic, higher more varied.

locality.topK.description: Top-k sampling: keep only the K most likely tokens at each step (0 disables).

locality.topP.description: Top-p (nucleus) sampling: keep the smallest token set whose cumulative probability reaches p (1 disables).

locality.reasoningBudget.description: Per-request llama.cpp reasoning budget: a positive integer sets the token threshold; null (empty in Locality settings) means unlimited.

locality.reasoningEfforts.description: Additional reasoning-effort choices shown in settings. Each key is the display label and its value is sent as llama.cpp reasoning_effort. Default is built in; use Activate Reasoning to turn reasoning on or off.

locality.titlePrompt.default: Summarize the user message in 2-6 words. Output ONLY the summary.
locality.titlePrompt.description: Instructions for generating a new chat's title. The first user message is appended automatically.

locality.commitMessagePrompt.default: Write a concise Git commit message. Use an imperative subject line and add a short body only when it materially improves clarity.
locality.commitMessagePrompt.description: Instructions for commit-message generation. The staged diff is appended automatically; use this to require formats such as Conventional Commits.

locality.showThinking.description: Show completed model thoughts in chat and tool history. Current thinking remains visible while active.

locality.steerWithEnter.description: Steer/Queue messages: when enabled, Enter steers the running response and Ctrl+Enter queues. When disabled, Enter queues and Ctrl+Enter steers.

locality.memoryEnabled.description: Expose search_memories and recall_memory to the model for active summaries from other chats in this workspace, independently of file read tools, initial memory loading, and automatic generation. Enable in workspace settings; user-level values are ignored.

locality.memoryLoadOnStart.description: Load relevant active workspace memories into model context from the first message of a new chat. Independent of memory tool access and automatic generation. Already loaded context is retained when switched off. Enable in workspace settings; user-level values are ignored.

locality.autoGenerateMemories.description: Automatically create or update a memory when an Act or Review response finishes, independently of memory loading and tool access. Manual generation and editing remain available when off. Enable in workspace settings; user-level values are ignored.

locality.memoryMaxCount.description: Maximum number of relevant memories loaded at the start of a chat or matches returned by each search_memories call. The agent chooses which search results to recall.

locality.autoCompact.description: Automatically compact context when usage reaches the configured threshold.

locality.autoCompactThresholdPercent.description: Context usage percentage at which auto-compaction runs.

locality.tailBudgetPercent.description: Share of the context window (percent) reserved for keeping the most recent messages verbatim through compaction.

locality.maxMessageTokensPercent.description: Per-message size cap (percent of the context window). A single message larger than this (e.g. a big file read or command output) is middle-truncated with an elision marker so it can never overflow the context on its own.

locality.templateOverheadTokensPerMessag.description: Approximate chat-template/special tokens llama.cpp adds per message. Added to the exact /tokenize counts so the context guard does not under-count the rendered prompt.

locality.autoapproveReads.description: Auto-approve read_file / list_dir / glob tool calls.

locality.readToolsEnabled.description: Enable workspace file, image, and directory read tools. Memory tools have their own activation switch.

locality.editToolsEnabled.description: Enable workspace file creation and editing tools.

locality.commandToolsEnabled.description: Enable command and managed process tools.

locality.autoapproveWrites.description: Auto-approve file edit tool calls (workspace only).

locality.autoapproveCommands.description: Auto-approve all command tool calls in Act mode. Off by default.
